title: 第201章 荒泷天下第一斗
slug: 在须弥假装是一个学者
content_zh:
作为酒馆的招待，帕霍自认为也是见多识广了。

什么盗宝团，什么执灯人，什么商人，坏人，好人的，他都见识过。

但刚刚进门的客人，还是让他有些没绷住。

这是一个体格健壮的大汉，肤色上带有深黑色的诡异纹路，连指甲盖也是深黑色的。

当然，最引人注目的，还是对方头顶那一对红色的弯角。

众人都感到不可思议，这两幅画，各有秋千，难分上下，一时都不知道该怎么评价了。

只是由于从未有人如此走过，所以没有道路，全凭徐阳轻功好，在乱径中找出了一条不算路的路。

毕竟，这城池的城门后面的金凤国武馆弟子们和江湖义士们都是非常的卖力抵抗的。

吴笛开着车回到家中，当她停车走进别墅的刹那，并不知道，在她身后不远处，一个男人悄然现身。

他们在休闲区找了一个位子坐了下来，等着珠宝首饰鉴定交流大会的举行。

储天行在一旁没有出声，他的心里隐约有一丝担忧，宇浩这孩子默默无闻还好，如今这样的风头，对于他来说，也不知是好是坏。

只是，这人到底是谁？看她的武功招式也不像是江湖之人，而且内力深厚，在江湖上更是罕见。

已经升起的隔阂不提起并不意味着忘记，而今，贤妃主动提起，似乎有消除隔阂的意思。

现在想来，当时叶子峰应该就知道这团泥巴里面的物件，绝不简单，才会如此慎重。

反正没有人跟她讨论拍摄细节，她中途就出去了一趟，走到了外面透露着破败味道的拍摄场地。

随从们一听这话立马宽心，他们也跟随着连飞翰多次途径这恶劣村庄，但是每次皆是随意露宿，整夜任凭风沙吹打，因为这个地方的客栈实在太少太少，好像过了前方那个绿荫轩，便再也没有地方投栈了。

“白道友能理解就好，我还担心白道友会因此怎么看我。”杨决再度苦笑。

这样一踢，才发觉按压住肩膀上的理道并未松去。伸手一摸那伤口旁处，便触及到满手的粘稠，才知道这次受伤不轻。

“唔，我倒无所谓，夫君应该是饿了。”易显星硬着头皮，客气地回答道，其实这几日她的食量大增，她早已饿得前胸贴后背了，只是不好意思说。

平时都是通过发微信或者视频电话聊天，但总是各忙各的，通话的时间跟频次也逐渐降低。

“老刘，不是我不相信你，只是这里的情况你也知道，我们干了那么长时间不能就这样白白干活不是。”年龄最大的人也就是刘明嘴中的田三立即回到。

江彦轻轻抬手，灵魂锁链贯穿仅剩的三人，身子一动，便进入隐身状态。

而气愤的林有容，根本也无力去管此刻别人怎么看她，她找到了自己的那个直播房间，就走了进去。

苏澜在背篓里挑挑拣拣，终于被她找出了一株有清毒药性的草药。

得到这滴黑墨后，诡异的黑影竟然发生了异变！原本似人非人，似兽非兽的诡异黑影正在显出具体的轮廓，隐约间有细长的腿从黑影里脱变出来。

七玄真人沉思了许久，也没有想出什么好的办法，只得轻叹道：“就依白芒道人道兄所言吧，等比赛结束了，再提这事。那时，说不定我们就想出办法了，对吗？”微微点头，众人都表示赞同，此事暂时就这样决定。
content_en:
As a waiter in a tavern, Paho thought he was well-informed.

He has seen all kinds of treasure thieves, all kinds of lantern holders, all kinds of businessmen, bad guys and good guys.

But the guests who had just walked in still made him a little nervous.

This is a big, muscular man with strange dark black lines on his skin, and even his fingernails are dark black.

Of course, the most eye-catching thing is the pair of red corners on the opponent's head.

Everyone felt incredible. Each of these two paintings had its own pros and cons, and it was hard to tell them apart. For a moment, they didn’t know how to evaluate them.

It's just that no one has ever walked through it like this before, so there is no road. It's all thanks to Xu Yang's qinggong that he can find a path that is not a road among the chaos.

After all, the disciples of the Jinfeng National Martial Arts School and the Jianghu martyrs behind the city gates were working very hard to resist.

Wu Di drove her car back home. When she parked the car and walked into the villa, she didn't know that a man quietly appeared not far behind her.

They found a seat in the leisure area and sat down, waiting for the jewelry appraisal exchange conference to be held.

Chu Tianxing remained silent at the side, feeling vaguely worried in his heart. It was good that Yuhao was unknown, but for him, the current limelight was not good or bad.

But, who is this person?Looking at her martial arts moves, she doesn't look like someone from the martial arts world, and her inner strength is deep, which is even rarer in the martial arts world.

Not mentioning the estrangement that has arisen does not mean forgetting it. Now, Concubine Xian takes the initiative to bring it up, which seems to mean to eliminate the estrangement.

Thinking about it now, Ye Zifeng should have known that the objects in the mud were by no means simple, so he was so cautious.

Anyway, no one discussed the details of the shooting with her, so she went out halfway and walked to the shooting location that smelled of dilapidation.

When the followers heard this, they immediately felt relieved. They also followed Lian Feihan through this poor village many times, but every time they slept in the open, letting the wind and sand blow all night long, because there were too few inns in this place. It seemed that after passing the green shade pavilion in front, there was no place to stay.

"It's good that Fellow Daoist Bai can understand. I'm worried about what Fellow Daoist Bai will think of me because of this." Yang Jue smiled bitterly again.

After kicking like this, I realized that the pressure on my shoulders had not loosened.When he reached out and touched the area around the wound, he felt the stickiness all over his hand, and realized that the injury was serious this time.

"Well, I don't care. My husband is probably hungry." Yi Xianxing bravely replied politely. In fact, her food intake had increased greatly in the past few days. She was already so hungry that her chest was touching her back, but she was embarrassed to say it.

We usually chat via WeChat or video calls, but we are always busy, and the time and frequency of calls gradually decrease.

"Old Liu, it's not that I don't believe you, it's just that you also know the situation here. We have worked for so long and we can't just work in vain." The oldest person, Tian San, who Liu Ming said, immediately returned.

Jiang Yan raised his hand gently, and the soul chain penetrated the remaining three people. With a movement of his body, he entered the invisible state.

The angry Lin Yourong couldn't care less about what others thought of her at the moment. She found her live broadcast room and walked in.

Su Lan was picking through the basket on her back, and finally she found an herb with detoxifying properties.

After getting this drop of black ink, the strange black shadow changed unexpectedly!The strange black shadow that originally looked like a human but not a human or an animal was now showing its specific outline, and slender legs were vaguely emerging from the black shadow.

Master Qixuan pondered for a long time, but could not come up with any good solution. He could only sigh and said: "Just follow what Taoist Brother Baimang said, wait until the game is over, and then mention this matter. By then, maybe we will come up with a solution, right?" Nodding slightly, everyone agreed, and the matter was decided like this for the time being.
